ym_instance.label: Yandex account
ym_instance.description: Borrow the Yandex account of a configured Yandex Music provider (single sign-in for the whole household) or use this plugin's own sign-in.

label_auth_borrowed.label: Using the Yandex account of the linked Yandex Music provider. Sign-in is managed there; nothing is stored or rotated by this plugin.

dialog_skill_name.label: Skill name
dialog_skill_name.description: At least 2 words. Globally unique across all Yandex skills. Examples: 'Music Assistant', 'My Music', 'Home Audio'.

external_base_url.label: Public HTTPS address of Music Assistant
external_base_url.description: The address Yandex uses to reach the webhook, e.g. https://ma.example.com. It must be HTTPS and reachable from the internet (reverse proxy, DDNS).

test_webhook_reachability.label: Test webhook reachability
test_webhook_reachability.description: Sends a sentinel POST to the webhook URL and reports the result. Catches DNS / TLS / reverse-proxy issues *before* you spend a Yandex moderation cycle on a broken setup.

pub_status_on_air.label: ✅ Yandex moderation passed — your skill is on air. Voice commands routed via Alice will now reach this skill on your Yandex Station.

pub_status_in_moderation.label: ⏳ Yandex moderation in progress (typically 5-15 min). Click Refresh status below to re-check.

pub_status_rejected.label: ❌ Yandex moderation rejected the latest deploy. Open the dev console to see the rejection reason and edit the skill, then click Update skill to re-submit.

pub_status_draft.label: ⚠️ Skill is registered but has never been published. Click Update skill (or re-deploy via Recreate) to submit it to Yandex moderation.

pub_status_unknown.label: ℹ️ Publication status not yet fetched — click Refresh status to query Yandex Dialogs.

refresh_status.label: Refresh publication status
refresh_status.description: Re-fetches the skill's status from Yandex Dialogs (one HTTP call). Useful while moderation is in progress to see when the skill flips to on-air.

dialog_activation_phrase_2.label: Alternative activation phrase #2 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_2.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_activation_phrase_3.label: Alternative activation phrase #3 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_3.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_activation_phrase_4.label: Alternative activation phrase #4 (optional)
dialog_activation_phrase_4.description: Optional. At least 2 words, or leave empty to skip.

dialog_skill_voice.label: TTS voice
dialog_skill_voice.description: Voice used for the skill's text-to-speech replies.

delete_skill.label: Delete skill
delete_skill.description: Permanently deletes the skill from Yandex Dialogs. Your Yandex sign-in is kept; use Reconfigure to create a new skill.

dialog_skill_id.label: Skill ID
dialog_skill_id.description: ID of the skill you created in the Yandex Dialogs developer console (Settings → Skill ID).

label_diagnostics_inactive.label: Diagnostics: webhook handler not active — no skill is set up yet. Use Reconfigure to create or register one.

manifest_banner_bundled.label: Skill manifest: bundled default ({0} intents, {1} entities). Use Export to copy it to {2} for editing.

manifest_banner_override.label: Skill manifest: override active at {0} ({1} intents, {2} entities).

manifest_banner_invalid.label: ⚠ Skill manifest: override at {0} is invalid — falling back to bundled default ({1} intents, {2} entities). Error: {3}

export_manifest.label: Export manifest
export_manifest.description: Write the current bundled manifest to {0}. Will not overwrite an existing override; use Reset first if you want to start over.

dialog_skill_override_paste.label: Manifest TOML to import
dialog_skill_override_paste.description: Paste the full TOML contents and click Import. If your browser strips line breaks, paste base64 with prefix data:base64,<base64-encoded-TOML> — base64 -i skill.toml will produce one. Cleared on a successful import.

import_manifest.label: Import manifest
import_manifest.description: Validate the pasted TOML and write it to {0}. Existing override is replaced atomically. The paste field is cleared on success.

validate_manifest.label: Validate manifest
validate_manifest.description: Re-parse the override file and report parse / schema errors without re-deploying to Yandex.

reset_manifest.label: Reset manifest
reset_manifest.description: Delete the override file and revert to the bundled default. Idempotent — safe to click when no override exists.

exposed_players.label: Voice-controllable players
exposed_players.description: Players Alice is allowed to control. Leave empty to expose all players known to MA — Alice will then accept voice commands for any player by name.

ai_fallback.label: Answer questions with AI
ai_fallback.description: Send questions that are not music commands («почему небо голубое», «расскажи про эту группу») to a Music Assistant AI engine and let Alice speak the answer. Follow-up questions keep the conversation going; «включи …» still plays music.

ai_engine.label: AI engine
ai_engine.description: AI engine that answers the questions. Engines come from AI plugins such as OpenAI-compatible.

use_different_instance_name.label: Use a different MA-side instance name
use_different_instance_name.description: By default the Skill name is also used as the instance name shown in MA's provider list. Turn this on to specify a different MA-side name.

instance_name.label: Instance name (MA-side display)
instance_name.description: Display name shown in Music Assistant's provider list. Independent from the Skill name.

label_auth_signed_out.label: ⚠ Not signed in to Yandex. Skill management actions are unavailable — use Reconfigure on this provider to sign in.

label_skill_missing.label: ⚠ No Yandex Dialogs skill is set up. Use Reconfigure on this provider and choose «Create the skill again».

open_dev_console.label: Yandex Dialogs developer console
open_dev_console.description: Opens the skill's page in the Yandex Dialogs developer console (moderation, testing, statistics).

options.qr: QR code in the Yandex app

cookies.label: Cookies from passport.yandex.ru
cookies.description: Paste the cookies as a «key=value; …» string or as the JSON export of a cookie browser extension.

options.existing: I already created a skill in the Yandex Dialogs console

options.adopt: Use the existing skill (re-register it with this Music Assistant)
options.recreate: Delete it and create a new skill

reconfigure_action.label: What do you want to change?

options.edit_skill: Edit the skill (name, activation phrases, voice)
options.webhook: Change the public address or the webhook secret

new_webhook_secret.label: Generate a new webhook secret
new_webhook_secret.description: Use this if the webhook URL leaked. The skill is re-registered with the new URL.

label_diagnostics_summary.label: Diagnostics: {0} webhook hits ({1} past auth) · last webhook {2}.

user.title: Yandex account
user.description: Borrow the Yandex account of a configured Yandex Music provider (one sign-in for the whole household) or sign in with this provider's own account.

method.title: Sign in to Yandex
method.description: Music Assistant signs in to Yandex Passport to register and manage the Yandex Dialogs skill on your behalf.

cookies.title: Sign in with browser cookies
cookies.description: Sign in to passport.yandex.ru in your browser, export its cookies and paste them below.

device_login.title: Confirm the sign-in
device_login.description: Open ya.ru/device, sign in to Yandex if asked and enter the code {0}. This step continues automatically once you confirm.

scan_qr.title: Scan the QR code
scan_qr.description: Scan the code with the Yandex app on your phone and confirm the sign-in.
scan_qr.progress_text: Waiting for you to confirm in the Yandex app…

skill.title: Yandex Dialogs skill
skill.description: Alice reaches Music Assistant through a custom Yandex Dialogs skill. Music Assistant can create it for you, or you can use a skill you created yourself.

create_skill.title: Creating the skill
create_skill.progress_text: Registering the skill in Yandex Dialogs…

duplicate.title: A skill with this name already exists
duplicate.description: Your Yandex account already has a skill «{0}» (ID {1}).

webhook_info.title: Point the skill to Music Assistant

edit_skill.title: Edit the skill
edit_skill.description: Changes are sent to Yandex Dialogs; a renamed skill goes through moderation again.

update_skill.title: Updating the skill
update_skill.progress_text: Sending the changes to Yandex Dialogs…

webhook.title: Webhook address
webhook.description: Change the public address Yandex uses to reach Music Assistant, or generate a new webhook secret.

abort.login_denied: The sign-in was declined in Yandex.
abort.update_failed: Yandex Dialogs did not accept the new webhook address. Check the address and try again.

errors.invalid_base_url: Enter a public HTTPS address (https://…) that is reachable from the internet; local and private addresses do not work.
errors.skill_id_required: Enter the ID of your skill.

config_actions.manifest_export_success: Manifest exported to {0}. Open the file in an external editor.
